name: Issue 3290: Silencing Rune silences nearby enemies after a 1s delay
contract: 802631 effect 183 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_TRIGGER_SPELL_DELAYED, a registered CoA effect (Spell::
EffectAscensionTriggerSpellDelayed, SpellEffects.cpp:498-538): it schedules a delayed CastSpell of the
trigger spell after Milliseconds(std::max<int32>(1, damage)) via m_Events.AddEventAtOffset, and
EffectBasePoints[0]=999 supplies that 999ms delay (matching the tooltip's '1.00 sec'). 803745 is a native
SPELL_EFFECT_PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA (radius index 8 = 5 yd) applying SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE to
TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY for 6000ms (SpellDuration id 32), matching the tooltip's 'for 6 sec'. No CoA
Verification note: both 802631 and 803745 have SpellInfo::GetExplicitTargetMask() == TARGET_FLAG_DEST_LOCATION
only (TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY has TARGET_REFERENCE_TYPE_DEST, not TARGET_FLAG_UNIT_MASK, confirmed via
the target-info table at SpellInfo.cpp:231). Spell::InitExplicitTargets (Spell.cpp:727-786) strips ANY unit
target that a caller supplies whenever the spell doesn't itself need TARGET_FLAG_UNIT_MASK
('m_targets.RemoveObjectTarget()'), so casting 802631 at a distant unit target is discarded - it never
carries through to EffectAscensionTriggerSpellDelayed's 'target = m_targets.GetUnitTarget()' (which reads
nullptr and falls back to 'target = m_caster'). Both the original cast and the delayed re-cast of 803745
therefore always center their destination on the CASTER's own position (confirmed live: with the fixture
creature 10 yd away, 803745 was confirmed cast via spell_cast_count but landed on neither the caster nor
the creature). Silencing Rune is architecturally a self-centered ground rune, matching its own tooltip
('Inscribe a rune' at the caster's feet), not a distant-target spell - this places the fixture creature
within the rune's real 5 yd radius of the caster instead of the draft's 10 yd distance.

steps.label: SETUP: target is not silenced before the 1s delay
CONTRACT: target is silenced once the rune activates
CONTRACT: the silence lasts around the tooltip's 6 sec
